contentClass.instructions: Classify the supplied page/content candidate after deterministic blocklists and exact rules have already run. Judge only whether the candidate itself is ordinary content, materially promotional/advertising content, or ambiguous.

criteria.ordinary: Primary editorial, navigational, functional or user-requested content with no material advertising, sponsorship, affiliate or promotional purpose in the supplied evidence.
criteria.promotional: The candidate materially promotes a product, service, sponsor, affiliate offer or paid placement, rather than serving as ordinary primary content.
criteria.ambiguous: The candidate mixes ordinary and promotional signals, or the supplied context is insufficient to classify reliably.
